transition-ph1: Q368 and Q443 share a new 500 kV switchyard on Hassayampa–North Gila #2 ($32M). Series-cap resizing ($24M) is needed because the new cut-in switchyards over-compensate the line. Q518 (32 MW, since withdrawn) triggered the Desert Sands 69 kV reconductors.
2025-ph2a: Reconductoring the 7-mile Hassayampa–Q564 500 kV line ($56M) is now split between Q596 and Q597 (630 MW NRIS) after Q599 left. Q603 (500 MW ERIS) carries no system NU.
cluster-2026: 7 requests (2.9 GW, all NRIS), including Q673 (500 MW) and Q674 (600 MW) at Orchard and two 500 MW requests at the HANG1 500 kV cut-in. These sit on the same Hassayampa–Hoodoo Wash–North Gila 500 kV corridor as the 2025 reconductor.
